keyword_evidence: Search and marketplace evidence supports octopus shaped rugs, sea monster/tentacle rugs, tree of life rugs, western horse rugs and running horse area rugs. B028 separates near-duplicate octopus and horse designs by visible color, scene and motif.
buyer_summary: B028 buyers include coastal and ocean decor shoppers, fantasy sea-monster fans, tree-of-life home decor buyers, horse lovers, western/ranch decor shoppers and gift buyers furnishing bedrooms, living rooms or themed spaces.
purchase_concerns: Shape accuracy, print clarity, color match, room fit, size choice, non-slip backing, softness, easy-care expectations, avoiding outdoor-only claims where not shown, and distinguishing similar octopus/horse designs.
